title: Make a Fool of Yourself
kicker: Everything you want is on the other side
blurb: Why the fear of cringe feels so big, why it is often wrong, and a week of small, deliberate foolishness.
description: Starting from advice Austin Butler recounted, the film looks at why embarrassment feels huge in a world of views and likes. Few people watch as closely as it feels, people are kinder than we predict, and cringe is how skill is built. It ends with a dare for the week.
takeaways: The fear of being judged is an old alarm, now ringing in a world of views, likes and seen markers.
The spotlight effect means people notice our mistakes far less than we think.
People who laughed at their own harmless mistakes were seen as warmer and more authentic.
Over a long time, people tend to regret what they never tried more than what they did.
Be foolish, never cruel: risk your own image, never someone else's dignity.
